correctness.rationale: At the pinned RESULT.md, L1=1+P_m p−P_n p and Fourier(P_b f)(k)=Fourier(f)(bk), so the claimed k≠0 equation is exact. For gcd(m,n)=1, extraction of maximal m- and n-powers gives unique r m^a n^b with m∤r,n∤r. Relations at r m^a n^b connect adjacent vertices of every fixed a+b=ell chain, proving identical coefficients; weighted Parseval handles L² and the independent [0,1] a.e. constraint handles positivity. A polynomial coefficient class survives iff its largest frequency r·max(m,n)^ell≤N, yielding exactly 1+2 sum_r(1+floor(log_max(N/r))) real dimensions; p=1/2 is a relative-interior witness. For any stationary L¹ density f, strictly convex integrable phi(t)=sqrt(1+t²), unitality L1=1, and equality of integrals force equality in each positive weighted inverse-branch Jensen inequality, hence f=f∘T_m a.e. Ergodicity of T_m forces f=1. The fixed point 0 yields singular delta_0, so no unrestricted uniqueness is claimed. These are infinite arguments, not extrapolations from finite checks.

value.rationale: The natural invariant-law inverse-design problem asks for every measurable state-dependent switch probability preserving the uniform law of two expanding maps. Giving all frequency-level degrees of freedom, the exact dimension of every trigonometric degree cutoff, an explicit nonconstant robust interior family, and a precise absolutely-continuous uniqueness/singular counterexample dichotomy is a motivated complete structural classification, not an arbitrary small computation. The number of freely selectable parameters is directly useful for calibrated feedback design. The transfer identity and Jensen argument are standard ingredients and do not independently confer value; the complete all-policy/all-cutoff classification is the substantive exact invariant.
residual_risks: Standard operator/Fourier ingredients may reduce conceptual novelty if a broader prior inverse-map classification is discovered; value is tied to the complete all-cutoff result, not to claiming a new transfer identity.

limitations: Coprime integer expanding slopes only; no claim for noncoprime m,n.
Fourier l² summability alone is insufficient for an admissible probability; pointwise 0<=p<=1 is additionally required.
Uniqueness concerns absolutely continuous invariant densities under 0<p<1 a.e.; delta_0 is always singular stationary.
Independent finite checks of 8,160 cutoff instances and 1,001 sampled witness points corroborate, but do not constitute the universal proof.
Góra–Boyarsky 2003 and Alshekhi–Ding–Rhee 2024 full texts inaccessible; best-of-knowledge O only, no absolute historical priority guarantee.
The package originated with self-review; no formal Lean proof or expert attestation was present, and none is fabricated.
